entities.summary: HD 6434 b, formally named Eyeke, is an extrasolar planet orbiting the star HD 6434, formally named Nenque. It has a minimum mass about half that of Jupiter. It orbits the star very close, over 2.5 times as close as Mercury orbits the Sun. For this reason it completes one orbit in only 22 days. Unlike true "hot Jupiters" like 51 Pegasi b, HD 6434 b does not have a circular orbit, but rather an eccentric one.
